title: [spec-gap] X.509 appendix normative text still specifies rejected SHA-512 native profile
description: Found by security review of bedw.19 vectors (kimi-k3 pass 2). spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md normative text is pre-migration: section 4 MUST-level formula addr = [0x02] + SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7] + IID (~L79-81), section 2 'the same key whose SHA-512-derived IID produces the node's addresses' (~L52-54), and security-relevant section 8 step 4 verifier address-binding recomputation via SHA-512 (~L208-214). A verifier built from section 8 step 4 would REJECT a certificate carrying the settled upstream AddrForKey SAN that test/vectors/x509_cert_profile.json (bedw.19) pins. The appendix is absent from the upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision's specs list (decisions.jsonl covers only 03/04/05/06/11), so the migration gap is un-remedied spec text, not just the stale section-4 worked example. Needed: rewrite sections 2/4/8-step-4 + worked example to AddrForKey(SPKI) per decisions.jsonl (analogous to bedw.11 R-X509-016/018/051 implementation-side bead).
close_reason: Stale bead: the migration it requests already landed as d2e95c385f 'fix(spec): migrate x509 cert address-binding to upstream AddrForKey' (2026-09-09 02:48, one day before this bead was filed from a stale-checkout review of bedw.19). Verified on current beads-worker-5 HEAD: (1) Section 4 formula now reads AddrForKey(subjectPublicKey) with decisions.jsonl citation — old '[0x02]+SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7]+IID' formula gone; (2) Section 2 text now derives link-local IID (SHA-512 profile, correct per 03-addressing.md §3.1) AND routable AddrForKey /128 separately; (3) Section 8 step 4 recomputes via upstream AddrForKey bit-packing with explicit MUST-NOT substitute the SHA-512 IID; (4) worked example now shows 020f:fdfc:fbfa:f9f8:f7f6:f5f4:f3f2:f1f0 for pubkey 000102...1f — hand-verified byte-exact against the normative algorithm in 04-network.md §6.2 and cross-checked against the pinned upstream anchor vector in test/vectors/x509-independent corpus test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json (bdbacfd8... -> 0200:848a:... matches the same algorithm). Remaining SHA-512 mentions (L67 link-local IID, L280 prohibition) are correct per the settled decision. No code or spec change needed; nothing to codereview. Note: bedw.19 (vectors file absent) remains open separately.
